label: Ventilation Settings
definition: Parameters that define mechanical ventilation configuration, including mode, rate, and pressure settings.

label: Jugular Venous Oxygen Saturation
definition: A physiological parameter measuring the oxygen saturation in the jugular venous blood, monitored as an optional variable.

label: Patient Monitoring Data
definition: Physiological measurements collected from patients at high temporal resolution for clinical assessment and research.

label: Intracranial Pressure Monitoring
definition: Continuous measurement of pressure inside the cranium used to monitor patients with traumatic brain injury.

label: Intensive Care Monitoring and Treatment Methods
definition: Clinical approaches and technologies for monitoring and managing critically ill brain-injured patients.

label: Glasgow Coma Scale Assessment
definition: A standardized assessment of patient consciousness and neurological status used in head injury evaluation.

label: Arterial Pressure
definition: The pressure of blood in the arterial system, typically measured using fluid-filled catheter-transducer systems.

label: Bedside Monitoring
definition: Continuous physiological monitoring performed at the patient's bedside using connected medical devices.

label: Intensive Care Treatment
definition: Therapeutic interventions and management approaches applied in intensive care settings.

label: Intensive Care
definition: A high-level clinical setting providing continuous monitoring and management of critically ill patients.

label: Pupil Score
definition: A clinical assessment of pupil size and reactivity, recorded as part of intensive care management monitoring.

label: Intensive Care Unit
definition: A hospital department that provides continuous monitoring and treatment for critically ill patients.

label: Patient Outcome
definition: The clinical result or status of a patient following treatment or monitoring.

label: Brain Injury Mechanism
definition: The physiological processes underlying brain damage from trauma.

label: Patient Data
definition: Individual patient information including monitoring, management, and outcome data collected within the BrainIT network.

label: Outcome Data
definition: Clinical results and patient status measurements recorded at discharge or follow-up from intensive care.

label: Brain Injury
definition: A clinical condition affecting the brain that requires intensive care monitoring and management in ICU settings.

label: Clinician
definition: Healthcare professionals employed in institutions supporting the monitoring or management of brain-injured patients.

label: Sensor Accuracy
definition: The degree to which a sensor's measurements conform to true values, used in data validation.

label: Pharmacological Therapy
definition: Drug-based treatment approaches that may be tested in clinical trials using standardized monitoring data.

label: Clinical Efficacy
definition: The demonstrated effectiveness of a therapeutic intervention in human patients.

label: Neurological Outcome
definition: A clinical endpoint measuring neurological status and recovery in brain-injured patients.

label: Electrocardiogram (ECG)
definition: A diagnostic test that records the electrical activity of the heart, used as a source for heart rate measurement.

label: Treatment Data
definition: Information documenting therapeutic interventions and management approaches administered to patients.

label: Non-monitoring Data
definition: Clinical data elements collected as part of the core dataset that are not continuously recorded physiological parameters.

label: Outcome Factor Attribution
definition: Assessment of whether patient outcome is due to head injury, other illness/injury, or a combination.

label: High-Resolution Monitoring Data
definition: Minute-by-minute physiological and clinical data collected from brain-injured patients in neuro-intensive care settings.

label: Transcranial Doppler
definition: A monitoring technique using ultrasound to measure blood flow velocity in cerebral arteries, included as an optional variable.

label: Blood Pressure Monitoring
definition: Continuous measurement of arterial blood pressure during patient monitoring.

label: Fluid-filled Catheter-transducer System
definition: A type of physiological monitoring system using a fluid-filled catheter connected to an external transducer for pressure measurement.

label: Blood-Brain Barrier
definition: The physiological barrier limiting drug penetration into brain tissue, relevant to neuroprotective drug efficacy.

label: Pre-Clinical Results
definition: Laboratory or animal study findings suggesting potential efficacy of a therapeutic agent.

label: Sensing Process
definition: The process by which a sensor measures or detects a clinical property.

label: Physiological Data
definition: Time series measurements of physiological parameters collected from patient monitoring equipment.

label: Head Up Tilt
definition: The angle of elevation of the patient's head, which affects hydrostatic pressure and cerebral perfusion pressure calculation.

label: Emergency Medical Services
definition: Pre-hospital emergency medical care and transport services.

label: Extradural Lesion
definition: A brain lesion located outside the dura mater.

label: Catheter-tip Transducer
definition: A type of intracranial pressure monitoring technology with the pressure sensor integrated at the catheter tip.

label: Traumatic Brain Injury Icu
definition: An intensive care unit specializing in the treatment and monitoring of patients with traumatic brain injuries.

label: Neuro-Monitoring
definition: The continuous measurement and assessment of neurological and intracranial parameters in brain-injured patients.

label: Medical Domain Knowledge
definition: Clinical expertise and contextual information relevant to interpreting and validating medical data.

label: Management Data
definition: Detailed information on clinical management and treatment approaches applied to brain-injured patients.

label: Physiological Monitoring Channel
definition: A continuous recording stream of a specific physiological parameter from bedside monitoring equipment.

label: Post-resuscitation Pre-intubation Condition
definition: Patient clinical status following resuscitation and prior to endotracheal intubation.

label: Mouth Care
definition: A routine nursing intervention involving oral hygiene and care of the mouth in intensive care patients.

label: Data Reporting Standards
definition: Guidelines for presenting and communicating monitoring data results across centres and at scientific meetings.

label: Brain Tissue Oxygen
definition: A physiological parameter measuring the partial pressure of oxygen in brain tissue, monitored as an optional variable.

label: Sampling Rate
definition: The frequency at which a sensor records measurements of a clinical parameter.

label: Computed Tomography Scan
definition: A diagnostic imaging investigation using X-rays to create detailed cross-sectional images of the body.

label: Neuro-intensive Care
definition: Specialized intensive care unit setting for management and monitoring of patients with brain injuries.

label: Medical History
definition: Patient history focused on previous neurological injury, substance abuse, and associated injuries.

label: General Medical Icu
definition: An intensive care unit that treats patients with a wide range of acute medical conditions.

label: Central Venous Pressure Monitoring
definition: Continuous measurement of venous pressure in the central circulation.

label: Intraparenchymal Monitoring
definition: A method of intracranial pressure monitoring using a catheter placed within brain tissue.

label: Data Provenance
definition: Information about the origin, history, and source of patient data, including how and when it was collected.

label: Traumatic Brain Injury
definition: A type of brain injury caused by external trauma, requiring intensive monitoring and management in specialized care units.

label: Monitoring Approach
definition: A standardized method or technique for continuous observation and measurement of patient physiological parameters.

label: Trial Drug
definition: A pharmaceutical agent being tested in a clinical trial for efficacy and safety.

label: Continuous Infusion
definition: A method of drug delivery in which medication is administered continuously via an infusion pump.

label: Neuro-Intensive Care Unit
definition: A critical care facility specializing in the monitoring and treatment of neurologically injured patients.

label: Management Approach
definition: A clinical strategy or protocol for treating or monitoring patients with brain injury.

label: Management Standards
definition: Established protocols and procedures for the clinical care of brain-injured patients.

label: Morbidity
definition: Disease or illness burden experienced by survivors of head injury.

label: Suctioning
definition: Nursing intervention to clear airway secretions.

label: Central Venous Pressure
definition: A physiological parameter measuring the blood pressure in the thoracic vena cava, monitored as an optional variable in intensive care.

label: Subdural Lesion
definition: A brain lesion located between the dura mater and brain surface.

label: Head Injury
definition: Injury to the head region with serious health consequences, including death and long-term morbidity in survivors.

label: Inappropriate Monitoring Method
definition: Monitoring approaches that fail to detect or adequately measure relevant physiological parameters.

label: Scientist
definition: Research professionals with expertise in neuroscience or related fields contributing to the network.

label: Hydrostatic Pressure Gradient
definition: The pressure difference between the head and heart affected by patient positioning, relevant to blood pressure transducer zeroing.

label: Main Lesion
definition: The primary brain lesion identified on CT scan, classified by type and volume.

label: Bolus
definition: A method of drug delivery in which medication is administered in a single, discrete dose rather than continuously.

label: Project
definition: A specific research initiative within the BrainIT network focused on a particular aspect of brain injury monitoring or management.

label: Researcher
definition: Professionals conducting research on brain injury monitoring and management.

label: Machine
definition: A medical device or instrument used to record or measure clinical parameters.

label: Injury Variables
definition: Clinical data describing the nature and circumstances of the traumatic injury.

label: Emergency Casualty Center
definition: Hospital emergency department providing initial acute care.

label: Inter-Species Difference
definition: Differences in brain injury mechanisms and drug responses between animal models and humans.

label: Bed Tilt
definition: A technical variable affecting hydrostatic pressure gradients between the head and heart in monitoring standardization.

label: Care Variability
definition: Differences in clinical care practices and treatment approaches across centres.

label: Study Design
definition: The methodological framework and protocol for conducting research on therapeutic interventions in brain-injured patients.

label: Cistern State
definition: Assessment of the status of brain cisterns on CT imaging, classified as present, compressed, or absent.

label: Guidelines for Management
definition: Established protocols and recommendations for the clinical management of severely head-injured patients.

label: Data Sampling Rate
definition: The frequency at which physiological data is collected, expressed as samples per unit time.

label: Endotracheal Tube Suction
definition: A routine nursing intervention involving suctioning of secretions from the endotracheal tube.

label: New Therapy
definition: Novel therapeutic interventions being evaluated for efficacy in brain-injured patients.

label: Structured Questionnaire
definition: A standardized interview tool used for outcome assessment.

label: System Damping
definition: A technical characteristic of fluid-filled pressure monitoring systems that affects the accuracy of recorded pressure measurements.

label: Admission Data
definition: Clinical information collected at the time of patient admission to the intensive care unit.

label: Measurement Capability
definition: The technical specifications and limitations of a sensor's ability to measure a clinical property.

label: Stratification Design
definition: The process of dividing study populations into subgroups based on relevant confounding factors for improved trial design.

label: Semantic Accuracy
definition: A data quality measure assessing whether data values are meaningful and correct within the clinical domain.

label: Intraparenchymal Lesion
definition: A brain lesion located within the brain parenchyma.

label: End-Tidal Carbon Dioxide
definition: A physiological parameter measuring the concentration of carbon dioxide at the end of exhalation, monitored as an optional variable.

label: Publication Standards
definition: Criteria requiring that only validated data be used in analyses intended for publication.

label: Interview Method
definition: The mode of contact used to obtain outcome information from patients or relatives.

label: Reading
definition: A recorded measurement value of a clinical parameter obtained from a sensor or machine.

label: Traumatic Coma Databank Classification
definition: A standardized nomenclature system for classifying CT scan findings in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Randomised Trial
definition: A clinical trial design where study participants are randomly assigned to treatment groups.

label: Line Renewal
definition: A bedside procedure involving the replacement of existing vascular or other lines.

label: Engineer
definition: Technical professionals developing and maintaining monitoring devices and data collection systems.

label: Theatre
definition: An operating room where surgical procedures are performed.

label: Confounding Factors
definition: Variables that may influence trial outcomes and require knowledge of their incidence for proper study design.

label: High Resolution Standardised Factors
definition: Detailed, precise, and consistently applied clinical measurement standards used in study design and analysis.

label: Respondent
definition: The person providing outcome information: patient, relative/carer, or combination.

label: American Guidelines
definition: Published clinical practice guidelines for the management of head-injured patients, including recommendations on cerebral perfusion pressure management.
